purpose: One second public LLM/MCP run after reading the measured v2 parent regression. No retries or seed sweep.
origin_selection: GPT-4.1 Mini chooses any verified compatible origin after reading diagnosis, origins, shortestPath, prior Decision outcomes and weighted regression degree. Same origin is permitted; no authored substitution.
algorithm: FalkorDB Cypher weighted incoming degree on COMPARED_AGAINST. Each child edge weights sum of positive per-suite collision-rate deltas. Unknown support stays null; degree is descriptive, not predicted risk.
failure_policy: If trainer/provider unavailable, preserve the attempt and stop. No deterministic substitute training for this study.
release_comparison: Append-only DecisionOutcome compares against parent evaluations cited before training. Any higher collision count or lower goal count marks regression. All outcomes remain unshipped; no automatic release.
